The structure of U3Co12Pd6 (reduced formula UCo4Pd2) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3m (No. 166), with 21 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows Co and Pd centers each with 12 geometric neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements, while U centers have 20 neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 21 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Co and Pd 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, plus corner- and face-sharing between Co polyhedra and U 20-vertex polyhedra.
